scope.summary: An uncertain owned row-stream session is quarantined instead of reused: on a next_row timeout (or any connection-fatal driver error) the pinned session is left mid-fetch with no out-of-band cancel, so recover no longer hands that connection back to the slot; the first uncertain-session failure is recorded and the session is discarded rather than silently returned to service. The DB2/DB3 bind-slot half (reject unmatched named binds before driver ordering) is pinned by a bind-permutation regression table.
out_of_scope: the value-fidelity bind work tracked separately (db1-db4-value-fidelity)

entry_points.name: owned row-stream recover() quarantine + bind-permutation table
entry_points.trace: crates/oraclemcp-db/src/connection.rs: the row-stream records the first uncertain-session failure and recover discards rather than returns the connection to the slot. Quarantine fix landed in 312cbedc; the clippy::type_complexity cleanup of the bind-permutation test table (AcceptedRow/RejectedRow aliases, no behavior change) landed in 8e579647, which is the source and last-touch of this file. cargo test -p oraclemcp-db.
